# Structured transparency, version 1 (2020)

Andrew Trask, Emma Bluemke, Ben Garfinkel, Claudia Ghezzou Cuervas-Mons and Allan Dafoe, "Beyond Privacy Trade-offs with Structured Transparency", arXiv 2012.08347v1, 15 December 2020. https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.08347v1

This is the paper that introduced the term "structured transparency": enabling desired uses of information without enabling misuse. It argues that the barriers to doing so are "less fundamental than they often appear". The name was proposed by Eric Drexler (see the paper's acknowledgements).

Later arXiv versions differ substantially; cite version 1. A note at the head of the PDF, added by Eric Drexler, says so.
